entries.title: Matthew 28:1
segments: But late in the week, at the dawning into the first [day] of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.

entries.title: Matthew 28:2
segments: And behold, a great earthquake occurred! For coming down from Heaven, and coming up, an angel of [the] Lord rolled back the stone from the door and [was] sitting on it.

entries.title: Matthew 28:3
segments: His countenance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.

entries.title: Matthew 28:4
segments: And the keepers shook for fear of him and became like dead [men].

entries.title: Matthew 28:5
segments: And the angel answered and said to the women, Do not fear, for I know that you seek Jesus who was crucified.

entries.title: Matthew 28:6
segments: He is not here, for He has risen, as He said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.

entries.title: Matthew 28:7
segments: And go quickly and tell His disciples that He has risen from the dead. And, behold, He goes before you into Galilee. There you shall see Him. Lo, I have told you.

entries.title: Matthew 28:8
segments: And they quickly departed from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring His disciples word.

entries.title: Matthew 28:9
segments: But as they were going to report to His disciples, behold, Jesus also met them, saying, Hail! And they came and held Him by the feet and worshiped Him.

entries.title: Matthew 28:10
segments: Then Jesus said to them, Do not be afraid; go tell My brothers that they should go into Galilee, and there they will see Me.

entries.title: Matthew 28:11
segments: And as they were going, behold, some of the guard came into the city and declared all the things that were done to the chief priests.

entries.title: Matthew 28:12
segments: And being assembled with the elders, and taking counsel, [they] gave enough silver to the soldiers,

entries.title: Matthew 28:13
segments: saying, Say that His disciples came by night [and] stole Him [away] while we slept.

entries.title: Matthew 28:14
segments: And if this comes to the governor's ears, we will persuade him and make you free from care.

entries.title: Matthew 28:15
segments: And taking the silver, they did as they were taught. And this saying was spread among the Jews until today.

entries.title: Matthew 28:16
segments: And the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had appointed them.

entries.title: Matthew 28:17
segments: And when they saw Him, they worshiped Him. But some doubted.

entries.title: Matthew 28:18
segments: And Jesus came and spoke to them, saying, All authority is given to Me in Heaven and in earth.

entries.title: Matthew 28:19
segments: Therefore go and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

entries.title: Matthew 28:20
segments: teaching them to observe all things, whatever I commanded you. And, behold, I am with you all the days until the end of the world.
